title: Doggo Hub
features:
Player ESP - Role based ESP for players (Killer / Innocent)
Show Names - Toggle player name display
Show Distance - Toggle player distance display
Innocent Color - Change innocent ESP color
Killer Color - Change killer ESP color
Generator ESP - Shows generators with progress like 25/100
Fuse Box ESP - Shows fuse box locations
Escape ESP - Shows escape locations
Door ESP - Shows doors and double doors
World ESP Colors - Separate color pickers for generators, fuse boxes, escapes, and doors
Auto Safe - Teleports you to the farthest generator when killer is close
Trigger Distance - Sets how close killer must be before Auto Safe activates
Generator Progress - Starts selected incomplete generator process
Fly - Free fly with WASD + Space + Shift
Fly Speed - Adjust fly movement speed
Noclip - Walk through walls / objects
Generator TP - Teleport to selected generator
Player TP - Teleport to selected player
Fuse Box TP - Teleport to selected fuse box
Auto Refresh TP Lists - Teleport dropdowns refresh automatically

NO KEY
NO ADS
